blocks.en: In this chapter we shall discuss nonlinear elliptic equations from three perspectives: the implicit function theorem, the calculus of variations, and nonlinear operator theory. This is the only chapter of the book in which we assume that the reader is familiar with the basic results of measure theory. In particular, we shall assume that the reader understands the following concepts and results.\begin{itemize}\item The definition of a set of measure zero and the idea of functions agreeing ``almost everywhere.\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\item The idea of Lebesgue measurable functions and the definition of the $L^p$ spaces as equivalence classes of functions that agree almost everywhere.\item The equivalence of the ``measure theoretic\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ definition of the $L^p$ spaces and the ``completion\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ definition used in the rest of this book.\item The idea of almost everywhere convergence of sequences of functions, the interrelationship between various types of convergence. This includes an understanding of such results as Fatou\textquotesingle s lemma and the Lebesgue dominated convergence theorem.\end{itemize}
blocks.zh: 本章从三个角度讨论非线性椭圆方程: 隐函数定理, 变分法和非线性算子理论. 这是本书唯一假设读者熟悉测度论基本结果的一章. 特别地, 假设读者理解以下概念和结果.\begin{itemize}\item 零测集的定义, 以及函数 ``几乎处处\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 相等的概念.\item Lebesgue 可测函数的概念, 以及将 $L^p$ 空间定义为几乎处处相等的函数所构成的等价类.\item $L^p$ 空间的 ``测度论\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 定义与本书其他部分使用的 ``完备化\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 定义的等价性.\item 函数序列几乎处处收敛的概念, 以及各种收敛之间的相互关系. 这包括理解 Fatou 引理和 Lebesgue 控制收敛定理等结果.\end{itemize}

blocks.en: Many results on differential equations say that a nonlinear equation behaves essentially like its linearization as long as one considers solutions which are small enough so that the linear terms dominate over the nonlinear ones. In Chapter~\ref{chap:introduction}, we stated the implicit function theorem from classical calculus, which provides such a result for finite-dimensional systems of equations. In this section, we shall generalize the implicit function theorem to a Banach space setting and then consider applications to elliptic PDEs.
blocks.zh: 许多关于微分方程的结果表明, 只要考虑足够小的解, 使线性项占优于非线性项, 非线性方程的行为就基本上与其线性化相同. 在 Chapter~\ref{chap:introduction} 中陈述了经典微积分中的隐函数定理, 它对有限维方程组提供了这样的结果. 本节将把隐函数定理推广到 Banach 空间的情形, 再考虑其对椭圆 PDE 的应用.

blocks.en: The Banach contraction principle is one of the most used techniques for finding solutions of nonlinear equations. It consists of the following theorem.
blocks.zh: Banach 压缩原理是求解非线性方程最常用的技巧之一. 其内容为以下定理.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $(X,d)$ be a complete metric space. Assume that $X$ is not empty and let $T:X\to X$ be a contraction, i.e., a mapping with the property that there exists $\theta\in[0,1)$ with the property that $d(T(x),T(y))\leq\theta d(x,y)$ for every $x,y\in X$. Then $T$ has a unique fixed point.
blocks.zh: 设 $(X,d)$ 为完备度量空间. 假设 $X$ 非空, 且 $T:X\to X$ 为压缩映射, 即存在 $\theta\in[0,1)$, 使对每个 $x,y\in X$ 都有 $d(T(x),T(y))\leq\theta d(x,y)$. 则 $T$ 有唯一不动点.
blocks.label: thm:banach-contraction-fixed-point
